title: Detailed Export Telemetry and Self-Hosted Source Support
summary: Looker's export process now provides granular telemetry via new ExportMetrics and ComponentMetrics schemas, alongside support for self-hosted instance sources.
details:
The ExportMetadata schema has been expanded to include an `exportMetrics` field, which provides deep visibility into the export lifecycle. This includes a new `ExportMetrics` object containing an array of `ComponentMetrics`. These metrics track performance and reliability data—such as `duration`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `retryCount`, and `sizeGb`—for specific export components including the Database (`DB`), File System (`FS`), and BigQuery Elite System Activity (`BQ_ESA`). 

Additionally, the `source` field in `ExportMetadata` now includes a `LOOKER_SELF_HOSTED` enum value, allowing developers to explicitly identify and handle migrations or backups originating from self-managed Looker environments.
